node.title: PMA petal-pattern root-pinning ledger
node.statement: For one maximal sunflower, the non-planted exact (d,t,h) petal-support stratum has field-independent size at most binom(M,t) binom(t ell,h) binom(k-1,max(0,2d+1-h)). Petal agreements satisfy h>d, so a fixed petal pattern and split locator determine the numerator and all background hits. At the L1 lower cutoff every fixed region (t ell-h)+max(0,2d+1-h)<=E is polynomial, including new growing-defect full-petal layers. The complementary unbounded petal-entropy/root-excess family remains open.
